content.text:
I fixed the layout bug, but the visual tests still fail on small text differences that I think come from the environment, not the site.

**The fix.** In `site/css/styles.css`, `.row-cols-2 > *` had `width: 25%` where Bootstrap has `50%`. The "Related products" grid showed four cramped columns on phones, with text wrapping one letter per line. It now shows two columns, as in the approved screenshots. The phone page height is back to 2202px, matching the baseline.

**What still fails.** Both tests (desktop and phone) still report about 1% of pixels different (7,668 on phone, 10,163 on desktop). The layout, colours and element positions match. What differs is the anti-aliasing and width of text glyphs, by 1–3px per line. The text inside the `600×700` and `450×300` placeholder SVGs differs too, and no CSS can change that. The font itself (Inter) renders slightly differently here than when the baselines were captured. I tried kerning and text-rendering variations and none of them matched.

I didn't regenerate the baselines, because that would replace the approved screenshots. If you confirm the current rendering is what you want, run `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots`.

I left the CSS fix uncommitted. `.idea` and `.vscode` were already untracked and I didn't touch them.

STATUS: NOT DONE
